# 👧 Shizuka Totem

## 👧 Shizuka Totem of Undying

A clean and soft anime-style totem inspired by Shizuka.

### ✨ Included Characters

If you want you can checkout the released version of the packs

- 🔵 Doraemon
- 👦 Nobita
- 👧 Shizuka
- 💪 Gian
- 🧠 Suneo

Each character is released as a separate pack, so you can choose your favorite.

### ✨ Features

- ✔️ Custom Shizuka totem
- ✔️ Vanilla-compatible
- ✔️ Multiplayer safe
- 
### 📥 Installation

1. Download your chosen character pack
2. Move it to .minecraft/resourcepacks
3. Enable in-game

### 📌 Notes

Single texture replacement pack
